prompt: Run /wiki-lint on my wiki at /tmp/test-wiki/. It has pages with missing frontmatter fields and broken internal links. Fix all issues found.

assertions.text: Runs lint_checks.py (or lint_checks.ts) to detect violations
Reports missing frontmatter fields (title, type, tags, sources)
Reports broken internal links between wiki pages
Fixes missing frontmatter by adding required fields
Fixes broken links by updating paths or removing dead links
Re-runs lint to confirm zero remaining violations
events.jsonl records the lint and fix operations
